Minimum controlled record: Mandatory. Dated authority map, working title, route, supervisor, decision owner, milestone map, SCOPE baseline, AI-use rule and initial risk record.
Review, approval and retention: Student owns the pack; supervisor reviews the scientific route; official topic or supervisor approval is retained separately where required. Store in the private authoritative project workspace.
Missing or stale record: control respons: Do not claim project start. Reopen orientation and the Problem Gate until authority, title, ownership and scope are controlled.

Minimum controlled record: Mandatory. One-page proposal, SCOPE, access requests, permissions or refusals, licence terms, pilot or vertical slice, evaluation sketch, early ethics, privacy and security record, premortem and decision.
Review, approval and retention: Supervisor reviews; data, system or organisational owner authorises access where applicable. Keep approvals and sensitive access evidence in a restricted area linked from the project record.
Missing or stale record: control respons: Reopen the Problem Gate. Stop collection or implementation beyond the authorised pilot until feasibility and authority are restored.

Minimum controlled record: Mandatory. Claim–Evidence Map, search and query logs, eligibility rules, CORPUS Ledger, original-source anchors, appraisals and synthesis memo. Conditional. Review protocol and amendment record for formal synthesis.
Review, approval and retention: Student maintains the pack; supervisor or method reviewer challenges coverage and quality. Retain lawful copies or stable locators, extraction records and dated synthesis decisions.
Missing or stale record: control respons: Reopen the Evidence Gate. Suspend unsupported claims and any design commitment that depends on the missing evidence.

Minimum controlled record: Mandatory. DECIDE record, alternatives, selected route, method, instruments, sampling or data plan, evaluation contract, provenance and fallback. Conditional. Ethics, data, security, licence or site approvals.
Review, approval and retention: Supervisor accepts the scientific protocol; competent external authority approves regulated access or activity. Store the approved version and every amendment in a restricted, versioned protocol area.
Missing or stale record: control respons: Reopen the Design Gate. Stop any unauthorised collection, intervention or deployment; repair the protocol before execution resumes.

Minimum controlled record: Mandatory. Frozen input, environment and context, work-unit briefs, code or instruments, logs, outputs, failed runs, deviations, recovery actions and acceptance or quarantine decisions.
Review, approval and retention: Student records execution; the relevant reviewer verifies local admission. Keep sensitive data separately, preserve immutable snapshots and link each accepted output to its producing state.
Missing or stale record: control respons: Reopen the Execution Gate. Repeat, repair or quarantine the unit. Never reconstruct a missing history silently after results are known.

Minimum controlled record: Mandatory. Analysis scripts, result tables and figures, source data or derivation record, baselines, uncertainty, counter-evidence, robustness checks, limitations and bounded claim register.
Review, approval and retention: Student owns the analysis; supervisor or method reviewer challenges inference and claim scope. Retain immutable result snapshots and direct claim-to-evidence links.
Missing or stale record: control respons: Reopen the Claim Gate. Narrow, suspend or withdraw the claim, or return to execution, design or evidence where the defect originated.

Minimum controlled record: Mandatory. Argument spine, section contracts, source-to-claim ledger, route-specific method, visual evidence plan, coherent draft and transverse TRACE record.
Review, approval and retention: Student maintains one authoritative manuscript; supervisor reviews intellectual coherence. Store manuscript versions with the rights register and links to source data for every material object.
Missing or stale record: control respons: Reopen the Argument Gate. If the prose exposes a scientific defect rather than a writing defect, return to the earliest responsible gate.

Minimum controlled record: Mandatory. Revision map, title and terminology lock, citation and reference audit, rights and attribution record, native figure and table sources, fields, bookmarks, SEQ records, accessibility report, authoritative DOCX, rendered proof, page map, manifest and hashes.
Review, approval and retention: Student or editor controls the package; publisher requirements govern delivery where applicable. Store the release candidate separately from working and restricted records.
Missing or stale record: control respons: Reopen the Editorial Gate. Any substantive change to method, result or claim reopens the corresponding earlier gate and invalidates the former proof.

Minimum controlled record: Mandatory. Current-session authority record, validated final PDF and hash, official upload and registration evidence, required declarations, slides, runbook, fallback, mock-defence record, independent test and final result record.
Review, approval and retention: Student owns consistency; supervisor, department, secretariat and commission verify only their competent parts. Keep personal administrative records separate from the manuscript and release archive.
Missing or stale record: control respons: Reopen the Defence Readiness Gate. Withhold submission or attendance until the official route is confirmed; substantive discrepancies reopen the relevant scientific gate.
